item.title: Brunswick Man Injured While Avoiding Deer With UTV
item.description: A 73-year-old Brunswick man had serious injuries in a UTV crash while avoiding a deer. item.title: Brookfield Man Charged Following Domestic Disturbance
item.description: A Brookfield man faces numerous charges after Brookfield officers responded to a report of Domestic Disturbance Thursday afternoon. Thirty-six-year-old Jonathan Scott Robison is charged with alleged two counts of attempted burglary, stalking, violation of an order of protection, resisting or interfering with an arrest, assault, and property damage. He is held with no bond allowed.
